title: MIT BLRU, IBM SkillsBuild Launch AI Lab to Accelerate Research and Democratise AI Skills
description: Bengaluru (Karnataka) [India], August 10: Manipal Institute of Technology (MIT) Bengaluru, a constituent unit of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), Institution of Eminence Deemed-to-be University, today inaugurated the IBM-MIT AI Lab - MAHE Intelligence GPU (MIG) at its Bengaluru campus in collaboration with IBM. The Centre houses a High-Performance Computing (HPC) facility and is designed to democratise access to Artificial Intelligence (AI). The Lab will provide advanced AI computing resources, research infrastructure, and digital skilling opportunities to students, researchers, and institutions across India.

title: Two CityUHK scholars elected to the European Academy of Engineering in recognition of their internationally acclaimed research achievements
description: Hong Kong, August 10: Professor Li Wen Jung, Vice-President (Talent and International Strategy) and Chair Professor in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at City University of Hong Kong (CityUHK), and Professor So Hing Cheung, from the Department of Electrical Engineering, have both been elected as Members of the European Academy of Engineering (EAE). They have been recognised for their outstanding contributions to artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled micro/nano-sensing technologies and statistical signal processing and intelligent algorithms, respectively.
